text:
Which statement about the reactions in the blast furnace is correct?
A
Carbon reacts with oxygen and heats the furnace.
B
Carbon monoxide removes the silicon dioxide impurity forming slag.
C
Iron(III) oxide is oxidised to iron.
Limestone reduces iron(III) oxide to iron.
D

options.label: A
options.text: Carbon reacts with oxygen and heats the furnace.

options.label: B
options.text: Carbon monoxide removes the silicon dioxide impurity forming slag.

options.label: C
options.text: Iron(III) oxide is oxidised to iron.

options.label: D
options.text: Limestone reduces iron(III) oxide to iron.
